## Survey instrument flow

```{mermair}

```



```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    START([Start Interview]) --> CONSENT[Introduction & Consent\nGaza: remote calls\nWest Bank: household visits]

    CONSENT --> Q1["Q1. Have you seen/heard\nof any donor logos?"]

    Q1 -->|Yes| Q2["Q2. For each recognized donor\nPerception of donor\n1–5 scale"]
    Q1 -->|No| Q3

    Q2 --> Q3["Q3. How familiar are you\nwith USAID?\n1=Very familiar ... Not at all"]

    Q3 -->|"Not at all familiar\nor Unsure"| USG
    Q3 -->|"Somewhat or\nVery Familiar (1 or 2)"| Q4

    subgraph USAID_familiar ["If Q3 = 1 or 2 (Familiar with USAID)"]
        Q4["Q4. What types of USAID\nactivities are you familiar with?\n(select all that apply)"]
        Q5["Q5. Current perception of USAID\n1-5 scale"]
        Q6["Q6. Perception of USAID\nbefore Oct 7, 2023\n1-5 scale"]
        Q7_neg["Q7. Why negative perception?\n(select all that apply)"]
        Q8_pos["Q8. Why positive impression?\n(select all that apply)"]

        Q4 --> Q5 --> Q6
        Q6 -->|"Q5 or Q6 = 1 or 2\n(Negative)"| Q7_neg
        Q6 -->|"Q5 or Q6 = 4 or 5\n(Positive)"| Q8_pos
    end

    Q7_neg --> USG
    Q8_pos --> USG

    subgraph USG ["Perception of U.S. Government & People"]
        Qu7["Q_. Perception of U.S. Government\n(1-5 scale)"]
        Qu8["Q_. Perception of U.S. people\n(1-5 scale)"]
        Qu9["Q_. Perception of U.S. policy\n(1-5 scale)"]
        Qu10["Q_. Perception of U.S. support\nfor Palestinians (1-5 scale)"]
        Qu7 --> Qu8 --> Qu9 --> Qu10
    end

    USG --> INFO["Information Treatment\n(randomized)"]

    INFO --> EXP_USAID

    subgraph EXP_USAID ["Exposure to USAID — if Q3 = 1 or 2"]
        Q9e["Q9. Benefited from\nUSAID activity?"]
        Q10e["Q10. if Q9=1\nWhat types of activities?"]
        Q11e["Q11. Know someone who\nbenefited from USAID?"]
        Q12e["Q12. if Q11=1\nWhat type of activity?"]
        Q9e -->|Yes| Q10e
        Q9e --> Q11e
        Q10e --> Q11e
        Q11e -->|Yes| Q12e
    end

    EXP_USAID --> EXP_OTHER

    subgraph EXP_OTHER ["Exposure to Other Development & Humanitarian Actors"]
        Q21["Q21. Benefited from\nany development activity?"]
        Q22["Q22. if Q21=1\nWhich donors funded it?"]
        Q21 -->|Yes| Q22
    end

    EXP_OTHER --> MEDIA

    subgraph MEDIA ["Media Use"]
        Q28["Q28. Listen to radio?"]
        Q29["Q29. if radio: Which stations?"]
        Q30["Q30. if radio: Frequency?"]
        Q31["Q31. Watch television?"]
        Q32_tv["Q32. if TV: Which channels?"]
        Q32_sm["Q32. Use social media?"]
        Q33["Q33. if social media 1-6\nWhich platforms?"]

        Q28 -->|Yes| Q29 --> Q30
        Q28 --> Q31
        Q30 --> Q31
        Q31 -->|Yes| Q32_tv
        Q31 --> Q32_sm
        Q32_tv --> Q32_sm
        Q32_sm -->|Uses social media| Q33
    end

    MEDIA --> DEV_PRI

    subgraph DEV_PRI ["Development Priorities"]
        Q38["Q38. West Bank: right or\nwrong direction?"]
        Q39["Q39. Gaza: right or\nwrong direction?"]
        Q38 --> Q39
    end

    DEV_PRI --> HH_CHAR

    subgraph HH_CHAR ["Household Characteristics"]
        Q40["Q40-Q41. HH size & income"]
        Q42["Q42. Employment status"]
        Q43["Q43. if Q42=1-3\nType of employment"]
        Q40 --> Q42
        Q42 -->|"Employed (1-3)"| Q43
    end

    HH_CHAR --> DEMO

    subgraph DEMO ["Respondent Demographics"]
        Q44["Q44. Age"]
        Q45["Q45. Gender"]
        Q46["Q46. Location / region"]
        Q47["Q47. Religion"]
        Q48["Q48. Education level"]
        Q44 --> Q45 --> Q46 --> Q47 --> Q48
    end

    DEMO --> CLOSE([Close / Thank You])
```
